name: The Attic Door to a Drowned World
description: An old family wooden wardrobe in a dusty attic suddenly opens to reveal a violent ocean and a distant lighthouse beam.
prompt: A cinematic wide shot of a dim Victorian attic with old trunks and cobwebs, centered on a cracked wooden wardrobe; the wardrobe doors open wide into a surreal hidden stormy ocean, crashing waves, tiny distant lighthouse beam, rain, mist, dramatic volumetric light from the opening, rich brown and teal palette, photorealistic, hyperdetailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: Some doors in old houses don't lead to memories... they lead to the sea. Which room in your house feels like it hides a secret?
